title: LDBC schema/import preload
description: Add bounded LDBC SNB schema/import adapter coverage so official PostgreSQL implementation tables exist before command-mode Query 1 execution.
result: LDBC native smoke can now create the official PostgreSQL implementation SNB table shape and load bounded test-data through JDBC CopyManager before command-mode execution. The official LDBC command progresses beyond missing table knows and now fails at Query 1 with FusionDB returning Invalid parameter placeholder: $1. Strict native gate remains failed, correctly, because LDBC native_status is gap and memtier/TSBS tools are not all available in the current PATH.
